units: <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 10:8">Mikv. X, 8</cite> <he>חץ שהוא תחוב באדם</he> an arrow sticking in a person’s body; <cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 7:9">Tosef. ib. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 8:9">VIII</cite>), 9.
<cite ref="Arakhin 15b:78">Arakh. 15ᵇ</cite> <he>חץ עד מ״ה אמה</he> the range of an arrow is forty five cubits.

<cite ref="Arakhin 15b:44">Ib.</cite> <he>אין חץ אלא לשון</he> arrow means (an evil) tongue (ref. to <cite ref="Jeremiah 9:7">Jer. IX, 7</cite>); a. fr. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 2:1:4">Y. Keth. II., beg. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>שחיצה</he>, read: <he>שחֶצְיָהּ</he>]—Pl. <he>חִצִּים</he>, <he>חִצִּין</he>, <cite ref="H00367"><he>חִי׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3:4">Lam. R. to III, 12</cite> (expl. <he>כמטרה לחץ</he> <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3:4">ib.</cite>) <he>כקורת ח׳ וכ׳</he> like the post for arrows (for military practice) at which all shoot &c.—Tanḥ. Nitsab. 1 (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:23">Deut. XXXII, 23</cite>) <he>חִצַּי כלין וכ׳</he> my arrows will be spent, but they (Israel) shall not cease; <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:23">ib.</cite> <he>חִצָּיו כלין וכ׳</he> his arrows will be spent, but the post will remain; <cite ref="Sotah 9a:11">Sot. 9ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 22a:3">B. Kam. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>אשו משום חִצָּיו</he> he is responsible for his fire, because it is his arrows (i.e. his action), opp. <he>משום ממונו</he> because it is his property which caused the damage.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 22a:5">Ib.</cite> <he>חציו דכלב</he> it is the action of (his) dog; <he>חציו דגמל</he> of his camel; a. fr.

<cite ref="Sukkah 12b">Succ. 12ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sukkah 15a">15ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ זכרים</he> plain shafts, opp. <cite ref="N01160"><he>נקבות</he></cite> shafts with a hole into which the arrow-head is sat.
